network_sources.route: pgmpy sdist from PyPI, read directly; pgmpy itself is NOT installed
network_sources.why_not_the_obvious_route: bnlearn.com fails TLS negotiation (TLSV1_ALERT_PROTOCOL_VERSION) from this machine, so pgmpy.utils.get_example_model and the canonical .bif/.dsc downloads are unavailable; guessed GitHub raw URLs 404

determinism.knowledge_selection: deterministic evenly spaced stride over the sorted true orientations; no RNG, so a network and coverage always give the same K
determinism.pair_sampling: deterministic stride over the sorted pair list; never adaptive, never a function of any computed radius

censored_and_limit_representation.censored_run: wall_until_timeout_s on a _meta row; never the key a measurement uses
censored_and_limit_representation.undefined_separation: separation is null with separation_status giving the reason; never encoded as a number such as 0 or -1
censored_and_limit_representation.unreached_radius: -1 is a sentinel, never averaged or plotted numerically (there are none in this data)
censored_and_limit_representation.measurement_limit: o_g0_extensions_intractable is a MEASUREMENT limit and is kept distinct from every structural rejection reason

largest_five_rerun.reason: the full budget was projected to spend about five hours producing mostly censored records; real data at a smaller sample is worth more

files.prediction_before_looking.md: directional predictions, committed before the descriptive table existed
files.preregistration.md: network list and (X, Y) selection policy, before any radius
files.analysis_summary.json: the aggregate numbers the report quotes
files.gate_predicate_swap.json: verification that the GAC gate predicate is verdict-identical
files.instances_enumgate_partial.jsonl: first partial run, kept not pooled
files.instances_run2_partial.jsonl: second partial run, kept not pooled

assumption_status.separation_distribution: BFS on the CPDAG. Depends on NEITHER Conjecture 2 NOR session 5 law. This is the session headline.
assumption_status.radii: exact under Conjecture 2, hence Anti-Exchange Case B (verified, not proved). Error direction inflates radii, favourable to the hypothesis -- caveat kept visible.
assumption_status.cpdags: computed from the true DAG: the oracle-CI idealisation. Real discovery on finite data returns a sparser skeleton. This is the largest scope limit.
